breadcrumb: Std 8 Science (English) — Unit 17: Plant Kingdom — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: The estimated number of plant species on the earth is 8.7 million. Among them 6.5 million species are living on land and 2.2 million species are living in the ocean. Out of them 4,00,000 species are flowering plants.

en.q: Out of the estimated 8.7 million species on earth, about ______ species are flowering plants.
en.explanation: 6.5 million species live on land and 2.2 million in the ocean.

ta.q: புவியில் மதிப்பிடப்பட்ட 8.7 மில்லியன் சிற்றினங்களில் பூக்கும் தாவரங்கள் ஏறத்தாழ ______.

questions.quote: In the traditional system of classification, the plant kingdom is divided into two sub-kingdoms: non flowering plants (Cryptogams) and flowering plants (Phanerogams). Thallophyta, bryophyta and pteridophyta are non flowering plants.

en.q: Thallophyta, bryophyta and pteridophyta belong to the ______.
en.explanation: Flowering plants are phanerogams.

questions.quote: Algae are chlorophyll bearing, simple and primitive plants. Some algae are very minute and float on the surface of water: phytoplankton. Algae living with fungi and mutually benefitted: Lichen. Algae reproduce by vegetative (fragmentation, Spirogyra), asexual (spore formation, Chlamydomonas) and sexual (fusion of gametes) methods.

en.q: Very minute algae floating on the surface of water are called ______.
en.explanation: Lichen is the symbiotic association of algae and fungi.

ta.q: நீரின் மேற்பரப்பில் மிதக்கும் மிக நுண்ணிய பாசிகள் ______ எனப்படும்.
ta.explanation: பாசியும் பூஞ்சையும் இணைந்த கூட்டுயிர் வாழ்க்கை லைக்கன் எனப்படும். (தாவர மிதவை உயிரிகள் – பைட்டோபிளாங்க்டன்)

questions.quote: The plant body of fungus consists of filament like structures called hyphae. Several hyphae are arranged in the form of network called mycelium. The cell wall of fungi is made of chitin. Parasitic fungi absorb food from living organisms with the help of special roots called haustoria. E.g. Cercospora personata causes Tikka disease in groundnut.

en.q: The network of several hyphae in a fungus is called the ______.
en.explanation: Haustoria are special roots of parasites.

ta.q: பூஞ்சையிலுள்ள பல பூஞ்சை இழைகள் (ஹைஃபா) சேர்ந்து அமைந்த வலைப்பின்னல் ______ எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: Fungi live as saprophytes on dead and decaying organic matter (E.g. Rhizopus). Lichen: fungi living with algae and mutually benefitted. Mycorrhizae: fungi living symbiotically with higher plants in their roots.

en.q: A fungus living on dead and decaying organic matter is called a ______.
en.explanation: Example: Rhizopus.

ta.q: இறந்த, அழுகும் கரிமப் பொருள்களில் வாழும் பூஞ்சை ______ எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: Antibiotics Penicillin (Penicillium notatum) and Cephalosporin are obtained from fungi. Fungi like Ashbya gossypii and Eremothecium ashbyii are used to produce vitamin B2 (riboflavin). Yeast contains enzymes invertase and zymase which ferment sugar molasses into alcohol.

en.q: Vitamin B₂ (riboflavin) is produced by the fungi ______.
en.explanation: Yeast enzymes invertase and zymase ferment molasses into alcohol.

ta.explanation: ஈஸ்ட்டின் இன்வெர்டேஸ், ஸைமேஸ் நொதிகள் சர்க்கரைப் பாகை ஆல்கஹாலாக நொதிக்கச் செய்கின்றன.

questions.quote: Table 17.2 Diseases caused by fungi in plants: Fusarium oxysporum - wilt disease in cotton; Cercospora personata - tikka disease in groundnut; Colletotrichum falcatum - red rot in sugar cane; Pyricularia oryzae - blast disease in paddy; Albugo candida - white rust in radish.

en.q: Red rot in sugar cane is caused by the fungus ______.
en.explanation: Blast disease of paddy is caused by Pyricularia oryzae; white rust of radish by Albugo candida.

ta.explanation: நெல்லின் குலை நோய் பைரிகுலேரியா ஓரைசேவால்; முள்ளங்கி வெள்ளைத் துரு ஆல்புகோ கேண்டிடாவால்.

questions.quote: Table 17.3 Diseases caused by fungi in humans: Trichophyton - ring worm (circular rash on the skin); Microsporum furfur - dandruff; Tinea pedis - athlete's foot.

en.q: Ring worm is caused by ______.
en.explanation: Dandruff is caused by Microsporum furfur.

ta.explanation: பொடுகு மைக்ரோஸ்போரம் ஃபர்ஃபர் என்ற பூஞ்சையால் ஏற்படுகிறது.

questions.quote: Fungi are placed as the third kingdom in R.H. Whittaker's five kingdom classification because of absence of chlorophyll and starch. Penicillin is known as the Queen of Medicine. It was discovered by Sir Alexander Fleming in 1928.

en.q: Penicillin is known as the ______.
en.explanation: Sir Alexander Fleming discovered it in 1928.

questions.quote: Bryophytes are the primitive and simplest group of plants; terrestrial and non-vascular cryptogams. Since they live on land and in water, they are named as amphibians of plant kingdom. Rhizoids fix the plant to the substratum. The male sex organ is antheridium and the female sex organ is archegonium.

en.q: In bryophytes, the female sex organ is the ______.
en.explanation: The antheridium produces antherozoids.

questions.quote: Economic importance of bryophytes: they prevent soil erosion; Sphagnum can absorb large amount of water, hence used by gardeners in nursery; peat, a valuable fuel like coal, is obtained from Sphagnum.

en.q: Peat, a valuable fuel like coal, is obtained from ______.
en.explanation: Sphagnum absorbs large amounts of water and is used in nurseries.

ta.q: நிலக்கரி போன்ற மதிப்புமிக்க எரிபொருளான கரிமக்கட்டி (பீட்) ______ இலிருந்து பெறப்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: ஸ்பேக்னம் அதிக நீரை உறிஞ்சுவதால் நாற்றங்கால்களில் பயன்படுகிறது.

questions.quote: Pteridophytes are the first true land plants with xylem and phloem. Hence they are called vascular cryptogams. Lycopodium is known as club moss. Equisetum is known as horse tail. Classes: Psilopsida (Psilotum), Lycopsida (Lycopodium), Sphenopsida (Equisetum), Pteropsida (Nephrolepis).

en.q: Lycopodium is commonly known as ______.
en.explanation: Equisetum is known as horse tail.

questions.quote: Economic importance of pteridophytes: ferns are used as ornamental plants; the rhizome and petioles of Dryopteris yield the vermifuge drug; the sporocarp of Marsilea (water fern) is used as food by some people.

en.q: The rhizome and petioles of Dryopteris yield a ______ drug.
en.explanation: Marsilea's sporocarp is used as food by some people. (A vermifuge is an anti-worm drug.)

questions.quote: Gymnosperms are naked seed plants, i.e. the ovule is not enclosed by ovary. The water conducting tissue is tracheid and the food conducting tissue is sieve cell. Classified into Cycadales, Ginkgoales, Coniferales and Gnetales.

en.q: In gymnosperms, the food conducting tissue is the ______.
en.explanation: In gymnosperms the water conducting tissue is tracheid; angiosperms have sieve tubes and vessels.

ta.explanation: ஜிம்னோஸ்பெர்ம்களில் நீர் கடத்தும் திசு டிரக்கீடு; ஆஞ்சியோஸ்பெர்ம்களில் சல்லடைக்குழாய், நீர்க்குழாய் உண்டு.

questions.quote: Cycadales: palm like small plants (E.g. Cycas). Ginkgoales: large trees with fan shaped leaves; Ginkgo biloba is the only living species. Coniferales: evergreen trees with cone like appearance (E.g. Pinus). Gnetales: possess advanced characters like angiosperm (E.g. Gnetum).

en.q: Ginkgo biloba is the only living species of the group ______.
en.explanation: It has fan shaped leaves.

ta.q: ஜின்கோ பைலோபா ______ தொகுதியின் ஒரே வாழும் சிற்றினம்.

questions.quote: The term 'Angiosperm' is derived from two Greek words 'angio' meaning box or closed and 'sperma' meaning seed. Habit may be herb (Solanum melongena), shrub (Hibiscus rosa-sinensis) and tree (Mangifera indica). Angiosperms are divided into two classes: Dicotyledons and Monocotyledons.

en.q: 'Angio' in the word 'Angiosperm' means ______.
en.explanation: 'Sperma' means seed.

questions.quote: Characteristic features of Monocotyledons: seed has only one cotyledon; fibrous root system; leaves with parallel venation; flowers trimerous and not differentiated into calyx and corolla; pollination mostly by wind. Examples: grass, paddy, banana.

en.q: Which of the following is a monocot?
en.explanation: Bean, mango and neem are dicots.

questions.quote: Taxonomy: The word 'taxonomy' was first coined by Augustin-Pyramus de Candolle. There are four types of classification: artificial, natural, phylogenetic and modern. Linnaeus' classification, in his book Species Plantarum, is the most famous artificial system.

en.q: The most famous artificial system of classification was proposed by ______ in his book Species Plantarum.
en.explanation: Bentham and Hooker's system is natural.

ta.q: மிகப் புகழ்பெற்ற செயற்கை வகைப்பாட்டு முறையை 'ஸ்பீசீஸ் பிளாண்டாரம்' நூலில் முன்மொழிந்தவர் ______.

questions.quote: Herbarium is the collection of pressed, dried plants pasted on a sheet and arranged according to any one of the accepted systems of classification. The largest Herbarium of India is in Kolkata, which has more than 10,00,000 species of herbarium specimens.

en.q: The largest herbarium of India is located in ______.
en.explanation: It has more than 10,00,000 herbarium specimens.

ta.q: இந்தியாவின் மிகப் பெரிய தாவரத் தொகுப்பகம் (ஹெர்பேரியம்) ______ இல் உள்ளது.

questions.quote: The rules and recommendations regarding binomial nomenclature were found in ICBN (International Code of Botanical Nomenclature), now known as ICN (International Code of Nomenclature).

en.q: The International Code of Botanical Nomenclature (ICBN) is now known as ______.
en.explanation: It has the rules for binomial nomenclature. (ICN = International Code of Nomenclature.)

ta.q: தாவரப் பெயரிடலுக்கான பன்னாட்டு விதித்தொகுப்பு (ICBN) இப்போது ______ என அழைக்கப்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: இதில் இருசொற் பெயரிடலுக்கான விதிகள் உள்ளன. (ICN – பன்னாட்டுப் பெயரிடல் விதித்தொகுப்பு)

questions.quote: Acalypha indica (Kuppaimeni) belongs to the family Euphorbiaceae. The paste obtained from the leaves is used to cure burns on the skin. The juice of its leaves is mixed with lemon juice to cure ringworm.

en.q: The paste of Acalypha indica (Kuppaimeni) leaves is used to cure ______.
en.explanation: Its juice mixed with lemon juice cures ringworm.

ta.q: குப்பைமேனி (அகலிஃபா இண்டிகா) இலைகளின் அரைவை ______ குணப்படுத்தப் பயன்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: இதன் சாற்றை எலுமிச்சைச் சாறுடன் கலந்து படர்தாமரையைக் குணப்படுத்தலாம்.

questions.quote: Aegle marmelos (Vilvam) - family Rutaceae; unripe fruit is used to treat indigestion, chronic diarrhoea and dysentery. Aloe vera (Sothu Katrazhai) - family Liliaceae; leaves cure piles, inflammations on the skin and peptic ulcer.

en.q: Aloe vera (Sothu Katrazhai) leaves are used to cure ______.
options: piles, skin inflammations and peptic ulcer
en.explanation: Aloe vera belongs to the family Liliaceae.

questions.quote: Solanum trilobatum (Thoodhuvalai) - family Solanaceae; leaves and fruits cure cough and cold; used in treatment of tuberculosis and bronchial asthma. Phyllanthus amarus (Keezhanelli) - family Euphorbiaceae; the entire plant is used for the treatment of jaundice and liver disorders.

en.q: The entire plant of Phyllanthus amarus (Keezhanelli) is used to treat ______.
en.explanation: Thoodhuvalai (Solanum trilobatum) cures cough, cold, tuberculosis and bronchial asthma.

ta.q: கீழாநெல்லி (ஃபில்லாந்தஸ் அமாரஸ்) முழுத் தாவரமும் ______ குணப்படுத்தப் பயன்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: தூதுவளை இருமல், சளி, காசநோய், மூச்சிரைப்பு நோயைக் குணப்படுத்தும்.
